context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt: Judge the attached 48-frame contact sheet only, blind to scores or dataset labels. Do not delegate or read other files. Frames run left-to-right, top-to-bottom, 6 columns x 8 rows. Does anything touch the camera car, even momentarily or partially? Prior sparse pass was ambiguous. Be precise about what is visible versus possible hidden contact. Reply exactly in six lines: VERDICT: contact | no_contact | indeterminate; CLOSEST_MOMENT: frame numbers 1-48 or none; ACTOR: involved actor; VISIBILITY: occluded, off-camera or between frames limitations; CONFIDENCE: low | medium | high; EVIDENCE: one or two sentences naming visible evidence. Choose one verdict and one confidence value.
response:
VERDICT: indeterminate
CLOSEST_MOMENT: frames 22-26
ACTOR: shopping cart pushed by a person
VISIBILITY: The cart’s rightmost extent is partly outside the view during its approach; contact below the image edge or between frames cannot be excluded.
CONFIDENCE: medium
EVIDENCE: The cart approaches closely, turns, and stops in front of the camera, with visible pavement between its nearest visible wheels and the lower foreground. No definite cart-to-car contact or impact displacement is visible, but the full clearance is not shown.
